headline: Brazil President Lula Rejects Protectionism and Promotes Asian Trade Deals
summary: Speaking in Manila following an Asian diplomatic tour, President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva stated Brazil sought new trade partners in China, Indonesia, and Vietnam rather than mourning US tariff increases. Lula called for expanded technology exports.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy, executing trade diversification strategies to mitigate potential US import tariffs.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Expanding bilateral export channels in Asia mitigates vulnerability to US trade barriers.
